newsitem.title: USA: MBf USA sees profit in Q1 after Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: MBf USA sees profit in Q1 after Q4 loss.

text.p: MBf USA Inc, which reported a loss in the fourth quarter ended December 31, said on Thursday it appears the company will be profitable in the first quarter of 1997, based on current business indications.

The company, which makes medical examination gloves, said it lost $160,369, or $0.04 a share, in the fourth quarter, compared with a loss of $151,476, or $0.06 a share, a year ago. Revenues climbed to $12.6 million from $10.6 million, Mbf said.
MBf officials said a restructuring in the first three months of 1996 included its exit from the condom business.
The company's shares closed up 1/2 Thursday at 4-1/8.
